facts.note: Bell strikes nine while the watch shows twenty minutes to nine; the uncle makes a scene about it at dinner.
After dinner he goes up to the library and stays there alone.
At 10:18 by his watch, a thump right above in the atelier, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
At 10:15 by his watch someone goes quickly up the stairs past the library door; at 10:21 someone comes quickly down. He did not see who; the door was shut.
Bastien Girard comes into the library at 10:32 by his watch; they sit together until the temple strikes eleven.
